description: Map where on Earth a person's ten planet lines fall (MC, IC, rising and setting lines), the line closest to their birthplace, and which lines run within 700 km of up to five places they name, each with an approved plain meaning and a link to the free astro map. Use when someone asks "where should I live astrologically", "my astro map", "astrocartography", "my Venus line" or "is Lisbon good for me". Lines come from an ephemeris checked against the Swiss Ephemeris and move about 1,000 miles per hour of birth time, so this needs an exact birth time and birthplace. Put the cities to check in places.

birth_place.description: Birthplace as city, region, country, e.g. Austin, Texas, United States. Gives coordinates (and the time zone if time_zone is left out).

birth_time.description: Local birth time, 24-hour HH:MM. Leave out if unknown.

latitude.description: Birthplace latitude, if the city is not found. Optional.

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude (east positive), with latitude. Optional.

places.description: Up to five cities to check for nearby lines, e.g. ["Lisbon, Portugal"]. Optional.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace, e.g. America/Chicago. Work it out from the birthplace. Needed with a birth_time unless birth_place is in our list.

name: get_astrocartography
title: Astrocartography lines
